# `dashboard/views/costs.ts`

## Overview

Provides HTML-rendering functions for the costs report dashboard. The module assembles stat cards, breakdown tables, dimension tabs, range pills, daily trend sections, and monthly summaries into HTML strings. Two functions — `costsBreakdownPartial` and `costsPage` — are exported for use by route handlers; all other functions are internal rendering helpers.

---

## Types & Interfaces

### `BreakdownDimension`

```ts
type BreakdownDimension = /* ... */
```

Represents the dimension by which cost data is grouped in the breakdown table (e.g. by service, user, or project). Members are defined internally.

---

### `BreakdownRange`

```ts
type BreakdownRange = /* ... */
```

Represents the time range applied to the cost breakdown view (e.g. today, this month, all time). Members are defined internally.

---

### `CostsPageData`

```ts
interface CostsPageData {
  todayTotal: number;
  monthTotal: number;
  allTimeTotal: number;
  breakdown: BreakdownRow[];
  breakdownDimension: BreakdownDimension;
  dailyBreakdown: DailyBreakdownRow[];
  monthlySummary: MonthlySummaryRow[];
}
```

Aggregated data object passed to the full costs page renderer.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `todayTotal` | `number` | Total cost accrued today. |
| `monthTotal` | `number` | Total cost accrued in the current month. |
| `allTimeTotal` | `number` | Cumulative all-time total cost. |
| `breakdown` | `BreakdownRow[]` | Rows for the active breakdown table. |
| `breakdownDimension` | `BreakdownDimension` | The currently selected breakdown dimension. |
| `dailyBreakdown` | `DailyBreakdownRow[]` | Rows for the daily trend section. |
| `monthlySummary` | `MonthlySummaryRow[]` | Rows for the monthly summary section. |

## Exported Functions

### `costsBreakdownPartial`

```ts
import { costsBreakdownPartial } from '...'

costsBreakdownPartial(
  rows: BreakdownRow[],
  dimension: BreakdownDimension,
  range: BreakdownRange,
  isAdmin: boolean
): string
```

Renders the dimension tabs, range pills, and breakdown table as a single HTML fragment. Exported so that HTMX partial endpoints can return this fragment when the user switches dimensions or ranges without a full page reload.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `rows` | `BreakdownRow[]` | The breakdown data rows to display. |
| `dimension` | `BreakdownDimension` | The currently active breakdown dimension. |
| `range` | `BreakdownRange` | The currently active time range. |
| `isAdmin` | `boolean` | Whether the current user has admin privileges (controls which dimension tabs are shown). |

**Returns:** `string` — An HTML fragment containing the tabs, pills, and table.

---

### `costsPage`

```ts
import { costsPage } from '...'

costsPage(
  data: CostsPageData,
  user: SessionUser
): string
```

Renders the full costs report page, including stat cards, the breakdown table (with tabs and range pills), the daily trend section, and the monthly summary section.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | `CostsPageData` | All cost data required to render the page. |
| `user` | `SessionUser` | The current session user. |

**Returns:** `string` — A complete HTML page string.
